prompt: Which pyridine N behaves most like a BASE?

options.label: Pyridine (N lone pair in-plane sp² — available!)
Pyrrole (N lone pair in the ring — tied up in aromaticity)
Aniline (N lone pair delocalized into ring — weakened)

explanation: Pyridine N: lone pair is in an sp² orbital in the plane of the ring, NOT part of the aromatic π system. Fully available to accept H⁺ (pKaH ~5.2). Pyrrole N uses its lone pair for aromaticity — protonating it destroys aromaticity (pKaH ~ -3.8!). Aniline's lone pair is diluted into the ring (pKaH ~4.6).
